hosts.description: The hosts to check, 1 to 50, with at most 200 names across them

200.description: One result per host, in the order asked

400.description: No host, more than 50, or more than 200 names across the hosts (`error.dns-check-too-many-names`)

404.description: A host does not exist or the user may not view it; nothing is checked then

description:
Looks up the A and AAAA records of each name through the check resolver and compares them with this instance's public addresses. A user who manages certificates also gets the record at the provider of a visible DNS credential that covers the name (always for Cloudflare, else only when the DNS answer is not this instance's address). A host checked within the last 30 seconds answers from the cache. Wildcard and regular expression names are skipped. A request ends within 60 seconds: a name not checked by then answers `unknown` with the reason `timeout`, and its host is not cached. At most 50 provider reads are made per request, and none more for a credential after it answered 429; the other names keep their DNS answer with the reason `provider-read-skipped`.

Needs: the view right of each host type
